name: Waiting time for elective outpatient medical visit (physician) in primary health care exceeds 7 days from assessment of the need for treatment, % appointments kept
limitation: Covers all non-urgent GP (physician) appointments in primary care, not only possible cancer. Counts appointments that were kept.

name: Referrals for specialised health care received processed within 3 days, % of referrals received
limitation: Measures how fast the hospital starts assessing a referral, not when the patient sees a specialist. Not cancer-specific. Counted per hospital organisation: East, Central and West Uusimaa and Vantaa and Kerava have no value of their own, so their card shows the HUS-wide value, labelled as shared.

name: Referrals for specialised health care received after processing for more than 21 days, % of the referrals received
limitation: Published as whole percentages and 0-3% everywhere, so it barely separates counties. Shown as context only, not used for ranking or stage status.

name: Proportion of women invited to breast cancer screening (mammography) who attended, %
limitation: Share of women invited to mammography screening who attended, so it says nothing about people who were not invited. Latest year is 2024. Listed on this page as context only: not shown on county pages and not used for ranking or stage status.

name: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %
limitation: Share of invited women and men who attended. The programme started in 2022 and is still widening its age band, so years and counties are not fully comparable. Latest year is 2024. Listed on this page as context only: not shown on county pages and not used for ranking or stage status.

name: Proportion of women invited to cervical cancer screening (smear test) who attended, %
limitation: Share of women invited to cervical screening who attended. Tests taken outside the programme (private or occupational care) are not counted. Latest year is 2024. Listed on this page as context only: not shown on county pages and not used for ranking or stage status.

name: Occupational health-care visits (physicians) per 1000 persons aged 15-64
limitation: Doctor visits in occupational health care per 1,000 residents aged 15-64 (working age). Counts visits, not people, and leaves out people over 64, who are most cancer patients. These visits are outside the public queue that the GP wait (6411) measures. Context only: one line on county pages, not used for ranking, status or actions.

name: Outpatient physician visits in primary health care for those aged 15-64 per 1000 persons of same age
limitation: Doctor visits in public primary care per 1,000 residents aged 15-64, shown next to the occupational figure for comparison. Includes maternity, student and mental-health visits. Counts visits, not people. Context only: not used for ranking, status or actions.

name: Reimbursement for visits to private physicians, recipients as % of total population
short_name: Private doctor visits reimbursed by Kela
limitation: Share of residents who got a Kela reimbursement for a private doctor visit in the year, any specialty, not only GPs. Visits with no reimbursement claim are not counted. Listed on this page as context only: not shown on county pages and not used for ranking or stage status.
